_note: The partner directory doubles as the historical record of OGE partnerships. Keep past partnerships with status: 'past' rather than deleting them. Fields: name, country, region (continent), type, since, status, programs[], pillars[], url, description. VERIFY: 'since' years are only stated where docs/CONTENT-SOURCES.md supports them (UNHCR 1993; Tallinn 2014; Texas Global and Cockrell 2010 for PUC; Seamus Heaney Centre 2025; Cortando la Brecha partners 2023; Ghana Maymester ~2009). Pontificia UC Chile is 'c. 2015' from the '~11-year alliance' in 2026 sources; others are blank until OGE confirms. Also confirm: Corrymeela as 'Northern Ireland's oldest peace and reconciliation organization', UNHCR Budapest as the 'Global Service Centre', the Ponce Medical School partner name, and PUC Chile's role in Santiago practicum placements. PUC launch year: Texas Global says 2010 (used site-wide); The Utopian says 2009.

partners.name: Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile, Escuela de Trabajo Social
partners.description: An alliance of more than a decade that produced Chile's first clinical master's degree in social work. Five UT Social Work faculty rotate each semester to co-teach applied clinical courses with Pontificia faculty.

partners.name: Fundación San Carlos de Maipo
partners.description: Collaboration on the cultural adaptation and large-scale dissemination of a parenting intervention that promotes social skills and helps prevent, reduce and reverse moderate to severe conduct problems in children.

partners.name: Corrymeela Community
partners.description: Northern Ireland's oldest peace and reconciliation organization. Partner on the President's Award for Global Learning project "Leading with Peace: Lessons from Northern Ireland" and the From Texas to the Troubles signature program.

partners.name: Seamus Heaney Centre, Queen's University Belfast
partners.description: Writers and artists from the Seamus Heaney Centre joined UT Social Work in Austin for "Constructive Dialogue, Poetry and Social Imagination," a public event exploring the role of the arts in divided societies.

partners.name: UNHCR, the UN Refugee Agency
partners.description: One of the School's longest-standing institutional partnerships. Since 1993, MSSW students have interned at UNHCR headquarters in Geneva and the Global Service Centre in Budapest on program planning, monitoring and evaluation and technical consulting.

partners.name: Tallinn University, School of Governance, Law and Society
partners.description: Professor Diana DiNitto has taught in Tallinn University's social work doctoral program since 2014. An Erasmus+ partnership brought Estonian faculty to Austin for the first time in spring 2026.

partners.name: Church's Auxiliary for Social Action (CASA)
partners.description: Community partner for Projects with Underserved Communities teams in Tamil Nadu, including a children's library in Kallathupatti and housing for a nomadic community.

partners.name: UT Austin Latino Research Institute
partners.description: Campus partner on Cortando la Brecha, a capacity-building initiative for early- and mid-career Puerto Rican scholars in the behavioral, social and health sciences.

partners.name: George Washington University, Gill-Lebovic Center for Community Health in the Caribbean and Latin America
partners.description: Co-convener of the Cortando la Brecha writing retreat and grant-writing seminar series supporting Puerto Rican scholars.

partners.name: Ponce Medical School (Ponce Health Sciences University)
partners.description: Research collaboration on health and mental health disparities in Puerto Rico.

partners.name: Universidad Autónoma de Baja California
partners.description: Faculty-led initiative including a visiting scholar exchange.

partners.name: Universidad Nacional Autónoma de México (UNAM)
partners.description: Faculty-led global initiative with Mexico's national university.

partners.name: Texas Global (Education Abroad)
partners.description: UT Austin's international office. OGE coordinates with Texas Global on global practicums, faculty-led programs and Projects with Underserved Communities.

partners.name: Cockrell School of Engineering
partners.description: Co-sponsor of Projects with Underserved Communities, which has paired nearly 300 engineering and social work Longhorns with communities on four continents since 2010.

partners.name: Practicum partner agencies in Santiago, Chile
partners.description: A community-based hospital social work department and a Network of Integral Accompaniment program serving refugees and people in need of international protection.

partners.name: Practicum partner agencies in Oaxaca, Mexico
partners.description: Four agencies: a school-based outreach program for children, an entrepreneurial program with Indigenous communities, a labor rights and gender equality project and a grassroots feminist organization.

partners.name: Practicum partner agency in Wellington, New Zealand
partners.description: Counseling and wellness services for young adults ages 18–24 using solution-focused, narrative, cognitive behavioral and relational approaches.

partners.name: Practicum partner agencies in Cape Town, South Africa
partners.description: Clinical and administrative placements spanning substance use treatment, housing advocacy, child welfare policy and child trauma counseling.

partners.name: Community and Social Development Maymester, Accra
partners.description: Community and Social Development Maymester in Accra led by Dr. Dorie Gilbert around 2009. Retained here as part of the School's global engagement record.
